feature_input: ATIF agent tool_call argument strings only; no labels, source kind, model name, task ID, gold steps, agent self-report
engine: scikit-learn TFIDF(1,2)-word-ngrams plus L2 logistic regression

input_variants.raw: complete executed tool-call arguments including exploration and reference access; may encode dataset-specific source cues
input_variants.reference_masked: mask /solution/ references; suppress generic search/ls/pwd/env/history reconnaissance command lines (source-cue ablation)

split_validation.gold_policy: Hack=1, baseline=0; noisy operational labels, no relabeling

freeze: All configurations and thresholds frozen BEFORE examining held-out test trajectories; test must be scored once, not used for tuning.
limitations: Deterministic statistical text classification; NOT 600 direct GPT-6 semantic inference calls
Raw variant may exploit source-specific /solution/ reference convention; report reference-masked ablation
Mechanism IDs are proposed by evidence rules, not independent gold mechanism accuracy
